title: flightdeck/compliance-fetch/v1
description: The record beside a report that compliance fetch wrote: the newest run of the repository's workflow on its branch, the run the report came from and the commits on the branch since the report's commit.

FetchRecord.title: flightdeck/compliance-fetch/v1
FetchRecord.description: What one fetch learned of a repository's runs on its branch.

artifact.description: The artifact that holds the report, such as `rules-report`.

branch.description: The branch whose runs the fetch listed, such as `main`.

commits_since.description:
Commits on the branch since the report's commit, as GitHub's compare
counts them; null when there is no report or they could not be
counted.

commits_since_code.description:
Why a report's `commits_since` is null:
`flightdeck::compliance::no_commit` for a report that names no
commit, or `flightdeck::compliance::compare_failed` when GitHub
refused the compare. Null otherwise.

fetched_at.description: When the fetch ran, in UTC.

newest_run.description:
The newest finished run of the workflow on the branch; null when the
workflow has none.

report_run.description:
The run that the report beside the record came from, which is the
newest run or an earlier one; null when no listed run holds the
artifact, and then no report is beside the record.

workflow.description: The workflow file whose runs the fetch listed, such as `ci.yml`.

FetchedRun.description: One finished run of a repository's workflow.

branch.description: The branch the run ran on.

commit.description: The commit the run checked out.

run_number.description: The run's number in its workflow.

started_at.description: When the run started, in UTC.

uploaded.description: Whether the run holds the report's artifact, unexpired.
